'''Caldin''' is an [[Aiel]] of the ''[[Aiel warrior societies|Hama N'dore]]'' society. 

== Appearance ==
He is graying and leathery.

==History==
Caldin is of the [[Goshien]] Aiel.{{ref|{{twotc|Caldin}}}}

He fought at a place called [[Sedar Cut]].

== Activities ==
He is in charge of the Mountain Dancers that accompanied Rand as an escort to see the [[Saldaean]] horse display outside [[Caemlyn]]. On the way back to the city, there was in an assassination attempt on Rand by the [[Children of the Light]]. It reminded him of Sedar Cut.

He is irritated when Rand bolts back to the [[Sun Palace]] without his Aiel escort.
